properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 — the ethereumjs hash library (SHA-1, SHA-224/256/384/512, RIPEMD-160) — declared at 2 lockfile sites as a transitive dependency of the truffle/ethereumjs stack. The D rating is driven by SHA-1/RIPEMD availability in the shipped library. Dependency inventory; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 npm package (pure-JS ECDSA over the Ethereum curve) pinned at 64 locations in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of the truffle/ethereumjs toolchain (ethereum-cryptography, ethereumjs-util, @truffle/hdwallet-provider). Dependency inventory: the build ships this implementation; no first-party call site in contracts, tests or scripts. Its live consumer here is the deployer config (truffle-config.js HDWalletProvider), and every XEN transaction is ultimately a secp256k1 ECDSA sig

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf (OpenBSD bcrypt_pbkdf — the bcrypt-based PBKDF used to encrypt OpenSSH private keys), declared 5× in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of sshpk in the truffle toolchain. Dependency inventory: this KDF ships with the build; no first-party call site. Changeable only by the upstream toolchain's dependency graph.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@^1.0.3 is a pinned transitive dependency in package-lock.json (node_modules/evp_bytestokey, line 6018; required by the truffle/hardhat toolchain's browserify-style crypto polyfills). It implements OpenSSL's EVP_BytesToKey — a single-round MD5-based KDF, rated C. No node_modules on disk and no first-party call site: this is dependency-tree presence, changeable here by pruning the toolchain deps.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 exposed by @noble/curves@1.2.0 (transitive dep of @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox-viem), and it is THE Ethereum curve: this project's deployment tooling signs every transaction with ECDSA over secp256k1 (truffle-config.js HDWalletProvider, hardhat.config.ts accounts — filed as findings). Observable and changeable here only as a toolchain choice; the EVM mandates secp256k1 ECDSA, so PQ migration of the signing path is ecosystem-gated, not repo-gated.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 exposed by the @noble/curves@1.2.0 dependency pinned in package-lock.json (transitive of hardhat-toolbox-viem). Available in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party call site found. Quantum-unsafe (Shor); migration target ML-DSA-65 if a use appears.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 pinned at package-lock.json:4656 provides ECDSA (P-256, secp256k1) and ECDH; transitively required by the web3/truffle stack. Available in the dependency tree; no first-party call site. Migration target ML-DSA-65 when a use appears.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.2.0 ships secp256r1 (P-256) ECDSA/ECDH implementations; declared once in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of the hardhat/viem toolchain declared in package.json devDependencies. Dependency inventory: the P-256 implementation ships with the build; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH key agreement ships via elliptic@6.5.4, declared in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of the web3/truffle stack. Dependency inventory: the ECDH implementation is present in the shipped tree (and quantum-vulnerable when used); no first-party ECDH call site — the XEN contracts perform no key agreement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (and 1.0.3 at top level) pinned in package-lock.json; X25519 (crypto.box/scalarMult) is available in the shipped dependency tree with no first-party call site. Harvest-now-decrypt-later class if ever used; migration X25519MLKEM768 hybrid.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is the KDF behind BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed derivation in the ethers/truffle wallet stack (@ethersproject/pbkdf2 is ethers' own module). No first-party call site; quantum-relevant only through its HMAC-SHA-256 core. Changeable by pruning dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak256 (SHA-3 family as implemented by js-sha3) is Ethereum's transaction and Merkle-Patricia-Trie hash; here it is present only as dependency entries used by the truffle/hardhat/viem toolchain. The first-party Solidity contracts contain no keccak256 at all (verified by grep across all 12 .sol files). No first-party JS call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.x — the scrypt KDF (RFC 7914) — pinned at 33 lockfile locations. It is the keystore/mnemonic KDF used by ethereumjs-wallet/hdkey on the @truffle/hdwallet-provider path (a devDependency this repo actually wires up in truffle-config.js to load deployer keys). Dependency inventory: present in the shipped tree; no first-party call site found. Note this is the same scrypt-js package the scrypt-js library object (LIB-73d70f43, other shard) names — one package, seen from the algorithm sid

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 ships via @noble/hashes@1.3.2, declared in package-lock.json (dep of the viem/hardhat toolchain). Dependency inventory entry; SHA-256 is Grover-only (no Shor impact), low urgency. No first-party call site — first-party code hashes nothing.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 exposed by @noble/hashes@1.3.2 in the shipped dependency tree (transitive of hardhat-toolbox-viem/@noble/curves); no first-party call site. BLAKE3 is a strong modern hash, Shor-irrelevant and Grover-resistant at 256 bits — recorded as presence, not weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/keccak exposed by @noble/hashes@1.3.2 (separate library from the js-sha3 entries under ALG-052c24b2 — kept as distinct library assets). Available in the dependency tree via @noble/curves/hardhat-toolbox-viem; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl's crypto_secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) available in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party call site. Symmetric AE with 256-bit keys — Grover-halved strength stays ≥128 bits, so this is presence-of-capability, not a quantum risk; rating A+ is consistent.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl (XSalsa20-Poly1305 AEAD, Ed25519, X25519, SHA-512) declared in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of bcrypt-pbkdf/sshpk in the truffle toolchain. Dependency inventory: these quantum-vulnerable primitives ship with the build; no first-party call site — this is the library-level entry corresponding to the algorithm-level tweetnacl objects (XSalsa20-Poly1305, Ed25519, X25519 in the other shard).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes is a pinned crypto library in the dependency tree (transitive of @noble/curves and @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox-viem), supplying SHA-2/SHA-3/keccak/BLAKE2-3/scrypt/ripemd. Available in the shipped tree; no application call site found — that limitation is recorded here, not a reason to erase.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves library, declared in package-lock.json as a dependency of the hardhat-toolbox-viem/viem toolchain (package.json devDependencies). Ships secp256k1, P-256/P-384, ed25519, x25519, BLS12-381 implementations. Dependency inventory: available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application — presence is the question this entry answers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is a pinned dependency at package-lock.json:10070; it is the scrypt KDF used by Ethereum wallets (BIP39 passphrase KDF) in the ethers/truffle toolchain. Available in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party call site. Scrypt is quantum-relevant only through its PBKDF2/HMAC-SHA core.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 (streaming SHA-224/256/384/512, browser-oriented) declared in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of the web3/truffle stack. Dependency inventory: ships with the build; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic is a pinned crypto library at package-lock.json:4656 providing ECDSA (P-256/secp256k1) and ECDH to the web3/truffle stack. Available in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party call site — presence is the inventory question here, not use.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js is a pinned dependency at package-lock.json:7014 (required by elliptic); it implements MD5/SHA-1/SHA-2 family hashes, including weak MD5/SHA-1 code paths that exist in the shipped tree. No first-party call site.
